title: India Atlas
game_overview: Explore an interactive map of India with state and city boundaries, estimating distances between random cities on a 0–6000 km slider.
winning_condition: Complete all randomly drawn quiz questions (between 5 and 10 per round) and maximize your total rating across every 1000-point challenge.
losing_condition: There is no elimination fail state; finishing the quiz with low accuracy yields a lower total rating out of the round maximum.

controls.input: Mouse Drag / Touch Drag on 0–6000 km Slidebar Arrow
controls.action: Slide the arrow indicator across the 0–6000 km range to select the estimated distance.
Type exact kilometers (0–6000) directly; stays synchronized with the slider bar.

controls.input: Left / Right Arrow Keys (Hold Shift for 100 km steps)
controls.action: Fine-tune the distance slider value in 10 km or 100 km increments.
Lock in the distance estimate, reveal the straight-line measurement on the map, and award rating points.
Tap -100 / -10 / +10 / +100 km buttons on mobile devices to fine-tune the slider.

sections.title: Visual Hierarchy & Layering
sections.content: Strict 3-Color Minimalist Light Palette: 1. Warm Alabaster / Soft Ivory (#F6F4EF / #FAF9F6) for the open ocean backdrop, elevated India landmass, and crisp HUD cards, with muted warm sand (#EAE6DC) for neighboring countries. 2. Deep Charcoal Slate (#1E293B) for crisp typography, hairline state and international boundary strokes, slider ticks, and precision markers. 3. Calm Mineral Teal (#1E7F74 with soft #E0F0EE wash) for active city boundary rings, the 0–6000 km sliding arrow control, primary action buttons, and the post-answer straight-line reveal. Airy whitespace, 1px hairline borders, and clean tabular typography create a serene, distraction-free cartographic experience.
sections.summary: Minimalist 3-color light aesthetic pairing warm alabaster, deep charcoal slate, and mineral teal.
